hooks.command:
jq -c '
  (.tool_input.subagent_type // "general-purpose") as $st
  | (.tool_input.isolation // "") as $iso
  | if $iso == "remote" then
      {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "Blocked by ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md rule: never kick off tasks into the background - each session should only have one task. isolation:remote always runs the agent in the background."}}
    elif $st != "fork" then
      {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: ("Blocked by ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md rule: never kick off tasks into the background - each session should only have one task. subagent_type " + $st + " is not fork; only Agent calls with subagent_type fork (which inherit context and run inline) are allowed here. Ask the user for explicit approval before spawning a separate background agent.")}}
    else
      {}
    end
'
